x: Down the straight Tobin increased his lead and Orton could not quite catch Harper, while "Champ" Smith had run well to get fourth position. Arthur Penny finished very strongly and Bert Shaw just pipped him for fifth place, which, considering how close he was to the winner, made Arthur doing a very good performance.

At this point I was pleased to notice the fine style and high position of "Champ" Smith. The waterlogged course was taking toll, and several dropped out here (ya yeller!), but Tom and Arthur went on relentlessly fighting each other across the golf course and its lake (very funny!) and they went down…
As Arthur's injuries improved, so he advanced to the Belgrave "slow pack" (led by George Still) and then further to the "medium pack" (led by, among others, "Champ" Smith).
